verdict.rationale: Qodo's pricing page lists "Strict data retention" as a plan feature and states that code is not used for model training and is used only to generate reviews. That is a first-party retention commitment, but it is a single thin mention with no documented user-facing settings for retention periods or deletion. Self-hosted and air-gapped deployment options are an adjacent control and are not credited as retention/deletion controls. missing for 10: documented user- or admin-configurable retention periods, a deletion mechanism for code, reviews and history, details of what "strict data retention" means, and independent corroboration.
